biography.value:
Description

A ghidra is a greater hydra with more heads, stronger bites, and stronger breath weapon.

Defense

AC 22, touch 10; flat-footed 20(+2 Dex, +12 natural, -2 size)

hp 168 (12d12+96); Fast Healing 10 [5 heads]

Fort +17, Ref +12, Will +11

Immune Paralysis, Sleep; Resist Earth 5, Fire 5, Ice 5, Lightning 5, Water 5

Offense

Speed 30 ft., Swim 30 ft.

Melee 5 Bites +16 (2d6+9), Tail Slap +11 (1d8+6)

Space 15 ft.; Reach 10 ft.

Special Attacks Pounce, 5 Breath Weapons (15-ft. cone, DC 20, 4d4 earth, fire, ice, lightning, or water, usable every 1d4 rounds)

Statistics

Str 22, Dex 14, Con 24, Int 2, Wis 13, Cha 11

Base Atk +12; CMB +20; CM 32 (can't be trip)

Feats Combat Reflexes, Great Fortitude, Improved Initiative, Improved Natural Attack (bite), Iron Will, Lightning Reflexes, Snatch, Toughness

Skills Perception +17, Swim +16; Racial Modifier +2 Perception

SQ Hydra Traits, Polar Bulwark, Pyric Bulwark, Fast Healing

description.value: A ghidra's fast healing ability is double to its current number of heads. A ghidra loses all fast healing when it is reduced to a single head.

Any critical hit has a 75% chance to sever a head. You cannot sever the last head but a ghidra loses its fast healing if they only have one head remaining. A ghidra can't attack with a severed head, but takes no other penalties. A ghidra also loses one of its breath weapons per head lost.

effect: On a critical hit 01-75 severs one head (not the last); lose one bite and one breath.

description.value: Once per day, a ghidra can become immune to physical damage for one round, must have at least two heads to use this ability and those two heads must channel this effect until the end of the round, while channeling, each other head may be used to perform an attack or a breath weapon.

effect: Once per day, a ghidra can become immune to physical damage for one round, must have at least two heads to use this ability and those two heads must channel this effect until the end of the round, while channeling, each other head may be used to perform an attack or a breath weapon.
Set remaining heads on Hydra Traits. This reserves two heads until the channel ends.
